title: The Refund Service That Pays Too Much
description: Partial refunds can exceed the original charge, and a rejected request consumes its retry key.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: RefundLedger(charged_cents) requires nonnegative integer cents. refund(key,cents) requires a nonempty key and positive cents, returns cumulative refunded cents, and must never exceed charged cents. Identical retry keys return the current cumulative total without paying again; conflicting amounts throw. A failed refund leaves totals and keys unchanged. C++ uses long long cents.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
